mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_media_job_submission(job_id, step, attempt_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{step}, #{attempt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_media_job_submission SET provider_task_id = #{providerId}, acknowledged_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE attempt_id = #{attempt} AND (provider_task_id IS NULL OR provider_task_id = #{providerId})
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id FROM afv_media_job_submission WHERE job_id = #{id} ORDER BY step FOR UPDATE
